approved: Customs Amendment (Banning Goods Produced By Forced Labour) Bill 2021
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would ban importing any goods made with forced labour, no matter where they come from.
It would add forced-labour goods to the list of prohibited imports under the Customs Act, with the same penalties that apply to other banned imports.
The ban follows a Senate committee recommendation and uses the Criminal Code's definition of forced labour.
Imposes an absolute, global ban on importing goods produced wholly or partly by forced labour.
Applies the penalties for prohibited imports to any goods found to have been made with forced labour.
Implements a Senate committee recommendation from June 2021.
Importers of goods into Australia and any businesses or consumers involved in supply chains that use forced labour.
